claims.passCondition: Equivalent trusted inputs rebuild the same semantic generation and exact materialization subject.
claims.counterevidence: changed subject digest, file set, lineage, or resource envelope

claims.passCondition: Only a current AUTHORIZE signature from the exact policy seat over the exact Tier-1 subject passes; HOLD, REJECT, forgery, drift, expiry, or root non-PASS closes the gate.
claims.primarySurface: Ed25519, scope, window, policy, roots, and drift adversarial tests
claims.counterevidence: wrong key, changed bytes, changed scope, stale decision, or root HOLD accepted
claims.observedEvidence: signature, choice, roots, drift, expiry, and wrong-key cases PASS

claims.passCondition: A separately signed current revocation snapshot is clear and the decision nonce is reserved exactly once in the selected Nursery ledger.
claims.counterevidence: revoked seat/key/nonce/digest, stale snapshot, or reused nonce accepted
claims.observedEvidence: all revocation classes and replay-after-discard/failure cases PASS

claims.passCondition: Writes create one new direct-child root under a canonical, existing, unlinked Nursery parent disjoint from protected source, workspace, and evidence roots.
claims.counterevidence: overwrite, traversal, alias, protected overlap, symlink, junction, or source/output overlap accepted
claims.observedEvidence: new-root, existing-root, dot-alias, protected-overlap, junction-parent, and junction-ledger cases PASS

claims.passCondition: Every candidate byte is written exclusively, read back exactly, and accepted by the Nursery inspector without importing or executing candidate code.
claims.primarySurface: real materialization, readback, tamper, source scan, and Nursery inspection
claims.counterevidence: byte drift, malformed bundle, candidate import, dynamic code, provider call, or process/network use
claims.observedEvidence: seven-file candidate, byte-tamper, static-inspection, and forbidden-capability cases PASS

claims.passCondition: Declared file/byte/attempt/process ceilings are enforced and durable receipts retain only digests, bounded measurements, verdicts, and path-free evidence.
claims.counterevidence: ceiling expansion, inconsistent total, source, raw goal, stdout/stderr, key, or machine path retained
claims.observedEvidence: resource totals, re-digested contradiction, and privacy assertions PASS

claims.passCondition: The exact candidate is separately authorized, executed in a repaired disposable sandbox, and verified on its native evidence surfaces.
claims.primarySurface: future sandbox, behavioral, browser, and human review evidence
claims.counterevidence: no execution evidence or failed acceptance behavior

claims.passCondition: Independent evidence proves the signing seat corresponds to the intended person and that the decision was informed and uncoerced.
claims.primarySurface: future identity, presentation, comprehension, and audit controls
claims.counterevidence: valid key signature without person or comprehension evidence
